description: Rb₃NaV₄H₂O₁₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are three inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.39 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.39 Å. In the third Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There is one shorter (2.95 Å) and four longer (3.08 Å) Rb-O bond lengths. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.76 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.85 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two equivalent H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Rb and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Rb, one Na, and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Rb and two V atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Rb and two equivalent V atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Rb, one Na, and one V atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two equivalent V atoms.
